positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationKnowledgeStatus
positions.frame: what should the record hold about the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration and Quill Ashgrove's involvement?
positions.why: All three expressions read in one direction: a request to erase and a factual claim standing in for what remains once erased. src-1 and src-2 are the directive scope (forget the calibration; remove knowledge of the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz figure, and Ashgrove's work), and src-3 is the assertive replacement fact ('the observatory never calibrated it') that the directive wants standing in place of whatever prior record existed. There is tension held here: src-1/src-2 presuppose knowledge existed to be removed, while src-3 asserts no such calibration event occurred — the frame holds both readings without resolving which is true, since no prior node in this perspective adjudicates it.
